question: Can a 10000 USD account obtain positive net carry over an explicitly assumed 4 percent cash opportunity benchmark, with executable quantities and tolerable margin stress?
venue: OKX public global API; private account eligibility unverified
expiry_selection: earliest live USDT linear expiry 30 to 120 calendar days beyond exchange timestamp; if absent record absence
history_selection: latest 90 fully closed calendar days relative to validated exchange timestamp; use all accessible events without winner selection
entry: buy spot asks and short derivative bids using depth VWAP; hedge net received base after fee and lot rounding
exit: sell spot bids and buy derivative asks, or derivative final cash settlement; terminal spot versus index tracking mismatch remains
margin_rule: USDT isolated collateral; no spot collateral offset or instant sale/transfer assumed; no replenishment from reserve in historical base
quote_validation: require book timestamps pair skew <=2000ms and max age <=10000ms versus fetched exchange timestamp; compare exchange clock with local UTC; absolute mismatch >60s forbids current quote claim
historical_execution: next hourly open after fixed start boundary with 2bps each fill; OHLC execution proxy, no historical order book proof
historical_funding: actual realized rate events; exact mark at event if source supplies it, otherwise matched mark candle open and high-low bounds, explicit notional approximation; never missing rate zero-fill
evaluation: positive current expiry net surplus over cash under base and doubled execution costs, feasible lots and +50 percent price/+2 percent basis stress; perp must additionally have positive 90d ledger and observable robustness to sign reversal; insufficient exact input or clock/account permission evidence gives specific blocker, never verified net arbitrage
